# seerr_issue_comment (Resource)

Manage Seerr issue comments via `/api/v1/issue/{issueId}/comment` and `/api/v1/issueComment/{commentId}`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issue_id` (Number) The ID of the issue to comment on.
- `message` (String) The comment message text.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date and time the comment was created in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) The comment ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the comment was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user who authored the comment.
